hassio_confirm.description:
Set up {name} so that it can check the wake words your voice satellites hear, and a television saying something similar does not run a command.

Checking is turned on separately, under Settings > System > General > Home Assistant Labs.

manual.title: Voice app

user.description:
The {name} app will be installed and started, so that it can check the wake words your voice satellites hear, and a television saying something similar does not run a command.

Installing takes a few minutes. Checking is turned on separately, under Settings > System > General > Home Assistant Labs.
user.title: Voice app

wake_word_verification.description:
Check the wake words your voice satellites hear against a second, more careful listener running on this machine, so that a television saying something close to "okay nabu" does not run a command.

Satellites that support it send the audio their own detector fired on, and the Voice app says whether it really was the wake word. Needs the Voice app installed and running.
wake_word_verification.disable_confirmation: Wake words will be taken as your satellites report them, without a second opinion.
wake_word_verification.enable_confirmation: This feature is still in development and may change. Satellites listen more readily while it is on, relying on the Voice app to catch what that lets through.
wake_word_verification.name: Wake word verification
